    [#AF87FF]spike[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]spike: De-risk the mutation path before any code lands: audit gog's HTTP[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]retry behavior on the mutation path in the upstream checkout, verify the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]write-call flag fence composes, settle whether label:bob search matches [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]messages labelled only bob/closed, and draft the honest gmail.modify [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]consent copy. Findings land as phase-bead notes; anything that bends the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]core contract is flagged loudly.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Archive-on-close machinery in bob-cli[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spike[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: Implement the opt-in gmail.sync.archive machinery: closed-task [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scan including done/, eligibility fold with one-shot journal events, the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]property-tested label-diff contract, the fenced per-thread batch modify [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]apply with receipt-label crash reconcile, login -s modify, doctor rows, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]report rows and additive JSON, burst breaker with -c, -n, first-enable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]backlog confirm, docs rewrites under a feat(gmail)!: subject, the new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decision record, and the bob-cli-i4 supersession.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Undo command and receipt surfaces[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]receipts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]receipts: Make every archive legible and undoable. In bob-cli the bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gmail unarchive command, the gmail_archived frontmatter and mail-note [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]banner lifecycle, the desktop notification, and the recent_archive JSON.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]In bob-plugins the display-only task chip, the banner's Move-back [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]button, the mail.base Archived-by-Bob view, and the morning notice line.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close-time notice polish[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]polish[dim] · [dim][/dim]after receipts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]polish: In bob-plugins, show the no-network close-time notice when a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]managed Done lands on a row watching an enrolled mail note while archive[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is enabled, and optionally a back-in-inbox chip on let-go rows. Pure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rendering of what bob reports; no network calls, no vault writes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gated live enable and verification[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]enable[dim] · [dim][/dim]after polish[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]enable: Opt Bryan in and verify live with him in the loop: set [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gmail.sync.archive on in the chezmoi bob config, update the Mac's bob to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a released build, have Bryan grant login -s modify, preview the backlog [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with sync -d, run the digest-confirmed live sync through a gate, verify [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every closed-task bob-labelled thread archived with its receipt, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exercise unarchive and let-go on a test thread.[/#D7D7AF]
